description: HDB Public Housing Building Under-Construction is a dataset listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by Housing & Development Board. This layer displays the HDB Public Housing projects, which are currently under construction. The locations of the sites are drawn using the site boundaries in the "layout of site" plans for the projects. The layer does not include developments such as DBSS, Executive Condominiums, etc. Coverage: Singapore. The portal files it under the publisher Housing & Development Board. It offers 1 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
